'''Terion Drel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]] who was exiled for questioning [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]]'s rule over the [[Eternal Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Terion Drel will send players a message if they invite the Zakuulan exiles to join their crew in Chapter IV: The Gravestone in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. If they choose not to, the player will receive a message about how Arcann's forces captured all of the exiles.
